name: Server Beacon
description: reports server status/health beacons to a station REST API.
project_description:
The Server Beacon module provides the ability to transmit reports about a server's status to a designated reporting station (provided by the Report Station ). 

 Report stations collect that information and can make it available for monitoring the health of an environment and inform maintainers of the availability of updates.

 Features 
 
 Provides options to provide PHP, web server and Linux versions 
 PHP Composer audits when Composer is available 
 Drupal module update information (via Update manager module). 
 Extensible to allow addition plugins to provide other server status info. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Build and manage server reports at /admin/config/services/server-beacon or

navigate to the Server Beacon Reports link on the admin web services page.

 From here you add and edit the various reports. Ensure that the transmitter

protocols match with the receiver configurations of the target report station.

 Additional Requirements 
 This module requires the following modules:

 
 Key module 
 Back to top
